## Problem

Describe the current behavior, who encounters it, and the desired result.

## Scope

List the affected files, routes, and dependencies. State the exclusions. Keep unrelated work in separate issues.

## Approach

Explain the proposed implementation and meaningful tradeoffs. Record Tim's acceptance of material design decisions before implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] State observable behavior that demonstrates this change works.

## Verification

Specify automated tests, rendered checks, relevant mobile and keyboard checks, and the preview or artifact to review.

## Compatibility and migration

Describe effects on existing content, addresses, Obsidian authoring, and private notes.

## Rollback

Describe a concrete revert or recovery revision and the checks that will verify it.
